summary: 0.2.8-beta1 speeds up wire processing and saved-circuit restoration, with the retained improvements enabled by default. Extension API 1.0.0 stays unchanged.
changes: Batch PG and CEE wires and spread saved-wire restoration across bounded work windows.
Reduce repeated loading calculations and retain native numerical safeguards on Windows and Linux.
Add regression fixtures for twelve logic, memory, supply and heater circuits.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.265, Java 21, Create 6.0.10, CEE 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.11. Set PG multiTicks to 16. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: The combined Pinout Stationary Yard also requires CC:Tweaked 1.121.0 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1. Circuit fixtures using fuses or rotary selectors require Power Components 1.3.0.
